messages:
Emily: Morning — thinking of a compact 3x30m micro-session series targeted at EU/APAC mornings (8:30–10:00 local). Each session = 20m talk + 10m live Q&A. Goal: live benchmark walkthrough + one short customer vignette + clear routing CTA to trial. Quick straw plan below. Ping ops + speakers.

Raj: Love it — can we split sessions by persona (Dev-first, Platform, Enterprise)? I can cover the Dev story and bring a short prompt engineering demo.

Zoe: Available for rehearsal 3/24. I can take the Platform session. Question: do we want a heavy live demo or recorded clips? Live demos in APAC mornings are risky. :grimacing:

Lucas: Strongly recommend recorded heavy demo (video) + a 5m live mini-tweak from the host to show interactivity. Have a fallback recorded clip for infra flakiness.

Priya: Draft abstract for the series: "Practical Inference: Real-world cost & latency wins — how teams get 3x cost reductions without latency regressions." Short bullets: 1) short benchmark baseline, 2) config levers (batching, prefix cache, quant profiles), 3) customer case, 4) ramp plan + CTA. Thoughts?

Emily: Nice — short & punchy. Here's a proposed run-of-show for each 30m slot (keeping tight):
```
00:00–00:02 Host intro & housekeeping (captions, Q&A flow)
00:02–00:12 Technical walkthrough (benchmark highlights + config changes)
00:12–00:20 Customer vignette (2min pre-recorded clip + 6min live q&a with customer rep)
00:20–00:25 Live micro-demo (host performs 1 small prompt tweak)
00:25–00:30 CTA + routing (trial link, contact, follow-up eval kit)
```

ops-bot: Heads-up — book webinar studio + captions workflow for 3/24 rehearsal and main dates (preferred window: 2026-04-15 to 2026-04-22). Auto-checklist added to the ops board.

Raj: Confirming speaker list: Raj (Dev session), Zoe (Platform session), Emily (Host/Enterprise intro), Lucas (demo video + fallback script). Priya to own abstracts & landing copy.

Zoe: Also recommend live captions + Mandarin subtitles for APAC session. Ops: can we auto-generate and upload SRT for the recordings?

Lucas: I'll produce the video and export SRT. I'll also include a 30s clip for the customer vignette if they approve. Backup plan: pre-recorded CLI run + logs screenshot.

Emily: Rehearsal slot: 3/24 17:00 UTC. Please RSVP. Action items: Emily finalize abstracts & calendar; Lucas produce video by 4/1; Raj prepare 5-min demo script; Zoe coordinate captions/translator; Priya draft landing page copy.

Priya: I'll draft the landing copy today and post in #marketing-drafts for review. ETA EOD.

Raj: RSVP done. Will upload demo script to the thread before rehearsal.

Zoe: RSVP. Adding note: include one poll question mid-session to boost engagement (which config had the biggest impact?).

Emily: Great — leaving this here as the canonical plan. I'll update the calendar invites and the ops checklist after lunch. :thumbsup:
